fullText.simplified:
第6章、新也的英雄

    徐元直站在新也城上，认真地看着城下的战场。
    已经打了一个小时了，“杀！杀！杀！”的叫声越来越大，人和马也越来越多。赵云和他的军队就像天上的云，一会儿在这边，一会儿在那边。
    曹仁带着兵去杀赵云。赵云跑得特别快，曹仁跟着他跑，也跑得很快。曹仁身后的兵没有他快，一会儿就看不到他和赵云了。曹仁还在跟着赵云跑，但是赵云跑得太快了，过了一会儿，曹仁也看不到赵云了。这时候，曹仁才发现自己身后的兵都不见了。他找了一会儿，吃惊地看到他们都已经死了，是赵云的兵从后面过来把他们杀了。
    曹仁很着急，也非常生气。这时候他看到赵云回来了，就马上又带着一些兵去杀赵云。但跑了一会儿，又像刚才那样，他又看不到赵云了，自己身后的兵也不见了，他们又都被杀了。
    曹仁的心跳得很厉害，他害怕了，他看不懂，他没有遇到过像赵云这样打仗的人。
    徐元直一直站在城上，他一会儿在新也的军队里找骑白马穿白衣的赵云，一会儿在曹军里找骑黑马穿红衣的曹仁。
    “保护新也！保护家！”赵云的声音徐元直听得很清楚。
    “杀！杀！杀！”新也军队的叫声徐元直也听得很清楚。
    现在城下的新也军队是四千人，曹仁的军队是三万人。四千对三万，这是死战啊！不管有什么聪明的方法，不管结果怎么样，这四千人都是新也的英雄。
    三个小时过去了。天快要黑的时候，徐元直终于笑了，他知道他的方法没错。
    新也城外终于安静了。曹仁带着两千多人往北方跑了，但是他回去的路不会好走，因为徐元直早就让张飞带着一千人在路上等着曹仁了。
fullText.traditional:
第6章、新也的英雄

    徐元直站在新也城上，認真地看著城下的戰場。
    已經打了一個小時了，“殺！殺！殺！”的叫聲越來越大，人和馬也越來越多。趙雲和他的軍隊就像天上的雲，一會兒在這邊，一會兒在那邊。
    曹仁帶著兵去殺趙雲。趙雲跑得特別快，曹仁跟著他跑，也跑得很快。曹仁身後的兵沒有他快，一會兒就看不到他和趙雲了。曹仁還在跟著趙雲跑，但是趙雲跑得太快了，過了一會兒，曹仁也看不到趙雲了。這時候，曹仁才發現自己身後的兵都不見了。他找了一會兒，吃驚地看到他們都已經死了，是趙雲的兵從後面過來把他們殺了。
    曹仁很著急，也非常生氣。這時候他看到趙雲回來了，就馬上又帶著一些兵去殺趙雲。但跑了一會兒，又像剛才那樣，他又看不到趙雲了，自己身後的兵也不見了，他們又都被殺了。
    曹仁的心跳得很厲害，他害怕了，他看不懂，他沒有遇到過像趙雲這樣打仗的人。
    徐元直一直站在城上，他一會兒在新也的軍隊裡找騎白馬穿白衣的趙雲，一會兒在曹軍裡找騎黑馬穿紅衣的曹仁。
    “保護新也！保護家！”趙雲的聲音徐元直聽得很清楚。
    “殺！殺！殺！”新也軍隊的叫聲徐元直也聽得很清楚。
    現在城下的新也軍隊是四千人，曹仁的軍隊是三萬人。四千對三萬，這是死戰啊！不管有什麼聰明的方法，不管結果怎麼樣，這四千人都是新也的英雄。
    三個小時過去了。天快要黑的時候，徐元直終於笑了，他知道他的方法沒錯。
    新也城外終於安靜了。曹仁帶著兩千多人往北方跑了，但是他回去的路不會好走，因為徐元直早就讓張飛帶著一千人在路上等著曹仁了。

sentences.traditional: 徐元直站在新也城上，認真地看著城下的戰場。
sentences.pinyin: xú yuán zhí zhàn zài xīn yě chéng shàng rèn zhēn de kàn zhe chéng xià de zhàn chǎng
sentences.english: Xu Yuanzhi stood in the upper side of Xinye, intently watching the battle that was happening in the lower side.

sentences.simplified: 已经打了一个小时了，
sentences.traditional: 已經打了一個小時了，
sentences.pinyin: yǐ jīng dǎ le yí ge xiǎo shí le
sentences.english: They had already been fighting for an hour.

sentences.simplified: “杀！杀！杀！”的叫声越来越大，人和马也越来越多。
sentences.traditional: “殺！殺！殺！”的叫聲越來越大，人和馬也越來越多。
sentences.pinyin: shā shā shā de jiào shēng yuè lái yuè dà rén hé mǎ yě yuè lái yuè duō
sentences.english: The screams of “Kill! Kill! Kill!” were getting louder and louder, and there were more and more men and horses.

sentences.simplified: 赵云和他的军队就像天上的云，
sentences.traditional: 趙雲和他的軍隊就像天上的雲，
sentences.pinyin: zhào yún hé tā de jūn duì jiù xiàng tiān shang de yún
sentences.english: Zhao Yun and his troops were like the clouds in the sky.

sentences.simplified: 一会儿在这边，一会儿在那边。
sentences.traditional: 一會兒在這邊，一會兒在那邊。
sentences.pinyin: yí huì'r zài zhè biān yí huì'r zài nà bian
sentences.english: One minute they were on one side, and the next minute they were on the other.

sentences.simplified: 曹仁带着兵去杀赵云。赵云跑得特别快，曹仁跟着他跑，也跑得很快。
sentences.traditional: 曹仁帶著兵去殺趙雲。趙雲跑得特別快，曹仁跟著他跑，也跑得很快。
sentences.pinyin: cáo rén dài zhe bīng qù shā zhào yún zhào yún pǎo de tè bié kuài cáo rén gēn zhe tā pǎo yě pǎo de hěn kuài
sentences.english: Cao Ren led his troops to kill Zhao Yun. Zhao Yun ran very fast. Cao Ren ran after him, and he was also very fast.

sentences.simplified: 曹仁身后的兵没有他快，一会儿就看不到他和赵云了。
sentences.traditional: 曹仁身後的兵沒有他快，一會兒就看不到他和趙雲了。
sentences.pinyin: cáo rén shēn hòu de bīng méi yǒu tā kuài yí huì'r jiù kàn bú dào tā hé zhào yún le
sentences.english: The troops behind Cao Ren were not as fast as he was, and soon they could no longer see Cao Ren or Zhao Yun.

sentences.simplified: 曹仁还在跟着赵云跑，但是赵云跑得太快了，
sentences.traditional: 曹仁還在跟著趙雲跑，但是趙雲跑得太快了，
sentences.pinyin: cáo rén hái zài gēn zhe zhào yún pǎo dàn shì zhào yún pǎo de tài kuài le
sentences.english: Cao Ren was still running after Zhao Yun, but Zhao Yun was running too fast.

sentences.simplified: 过了一会儿，曹仁也看不到赵云了。
sentences.traditional: 過了一會兒，曹仁也看不到趙雲了。
sentences.pinyin: guò le yí huì'r cáo rén yě kàn bú dào zhào yún le
sentences.english: After a while, Cao Ren also lost sight of Zhao Yun.

sentences.simplified: 这时候，曹仁才发现自己身后的兵都不见了。
sentences.traditional: 這時候，曹仁才發現自己身後的兵都不見了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou cáo rén cái fā xiàn zì jǐ shēn hòu de bīng dōu bú jiàn le
sentences.english: It was then that Cao Ren realized that all of the troops behind him were gone.

sentences.simplified: 他找了一会儿，吃惊地看到他们都已经死了，是赵云的兵从后面过来把他们杀了。
sentences.traditional: 他找了一會兒，吃驚地看到他們都已經死了，是趙雲的兵從後面過來把他們殺了。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǎo le yí huì'r chī jīng de kàn dào tā men dōu yǐ jīng sǐ le shì zhào yún de bīng cóng hòu miàn guò lái bǎ tā men shā le
sentences.english: He searched for a while and was shocked to see that they were all dead. Zhao Yun’s soldiers had come from behind and killed them.

sentences.simplified: 曹仁很着急，也非常生气。
sentences.traditional: 曹仁很著急，也非常生氣。
sentences.pinyin: cáo rén hěn zháo jí yě fēi cháng shēng qì
sentences.english: Cao Ren was very anxious and also very angry.

sentences.simplified: 这时候他看到赵云回来了，就马上又带着一些兵去杀赵云。
sentences.traditional: 這時候他看到趙雲回來了，就馬上又帶著一些兵去殺趙雲。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou tā kàn dào zhào yún huí lái le jiù mǎ shàng yòu dài zhe yì xiē bīng qù shā zhào yún
sentences.english: It was then that he saw that Zhao Yun had come back, so he immediately brought some soldiers to kill Zhao Yun.

sentences.simplified: 但跑了一会儿，又像刚才那样，
sentences.traditional: 但跑了一會兒，又像剛才那樣，
sentences.pinyin: dàn pǎo le yí huì'r yòu xiàng gāng cái nà yàng
sentences.english: But after running for a while, things were the same as before.

sentences.simplified: 他又看不到赵云了，自己身后的兵也不见了，他们又都被杀了。
sentences.traditional: 他又看不到趙雲了，自己身後的兵也不見了，他們又都被殺了。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu kàn bú dào zhào yún le zì jǐ shēn hòu de bīng yě bú jiàn le tā men yòu dōu bèi shā le
sentences.english: He lost sight of Zhao Yun again, and the troops behind him disappeared again. They were all killed once again.

sentences.simplified: 曹仁的心跳得很厉害，他害怕了，
sentences.traditional: 曹仁的心跳得很厲害，他害怕了，
sentences.pinyin: cáo rén de xīn tiào de hěn lì hai tā hài pà le
sentences.english: Cao Ren’s heart was pounding. He was scared.

sentences.simplified: 他看不懂，他没有遇到过像赵云这样打仗的人。
sentences.traditional: 他看不懂，他沒有遇到過像趙雲這樣打仗的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn bù dǒng tā méi yǒu yù dào guò xiàng zhào yún zhè yàng dǎ zhàng de rén
sentences.english: He did not understand what was happening, as he had never encountered anyone who fought like Zhao Yun.

sentences.simplified: 徐元直一直站在城上，
sentences.traditional: 徐元直一直站在城上，
sentences.pinyin: xú yuán zhí yì zhí zhàn zài chéng shàng
sentences.english: Xu Yuanzhi stood in the upper side of the city the entire time.

sentences.simplified: 他一会儿在新也的军队里找骑白马穿白衣的赵云，
sentences.traditional: 他一會兒在新也的軍隊裡找騎白馬穿白衣的趙雲，
sentences.pinyin: tā yí huì'r zài xīn yě de jūn duì lǐ zhǎo qí bái mǎ chuān bái yī de zhào yún
sentences.english: One moment he was looking among the Xinye army for Zhao Yun, who was riding a white horse and wearing white clothes.

sentences.simplified: 一会儿在曹军里找骑黑马穿红衣的曹仁。
sentences.traditional: 一會兒在曹軍裡找騎黑馬穿紅衣的曹仁。
sentences.pinyin: yí huì'r zài cáo jūn lǐ zhǎo qí hēi mǎ chuān hóng yī de cáo rén
sentences.english: The next moment he was looking among the Cao army for Cao Ren, who was riding a black horse and wearing red clothes.

sentences.simplified: “保护新也！保护家！”赵云的声音徐元直听得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: “保護新也！保護家！”趙雲的聲音徐元直聽得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: bǎo hù xīn yě bǎo hù jiā zhào yún de shēng yīn xú yuán zhí tīng de hěn qīng chu
sentences.english: “Defend Xinye! Defend our home!” Xu Yuanzhi could hear Zhao Yun’s voice very clearly.

sentences.simplified: “杀！杀！杀！”新也军队的叫声徐元直也听得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: “殺！殺！殺！”新也軍隊的叫聲徐元直也聽得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: shā shā shā xīn yě jūn duì de jiào shēng xú yuán zhí yě tīng de hěn qīng chu
sentences.english: “Kill! Kill! Kill!” Xu Yuanzhi could also hear the voice of the Xinye army very clearly.

sentences.simplified: 现在城下的新也军队是四千人，曹仁的军队是三万人。
sentences.traditional: 現在城下的新也軍隊是四千人，曹仁的軍隊是三萬人。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài chéng xià de xīn yě jūn duì shì sì qiān rén cáo rén de jūn duì shì sān wàn rén
sentences.english: Now, the Xinye army in the lower side of the city had 4,000 men, and Cao Ren’s army had 30,000 men.

sentences.simplified: 四千对三万，这是死战啊！
sentences.traditional: 四千對三萬，這是死戰啊！
sentences.pinyin: sì qiān duì sān wàn zhè shì sǐ zhàn a
sentences.english: 4,000 against 30,000. This was a fight to the death!

sentences.simplified: 不管有什么聪明的方法，不管结果怎么样，这四千人都是新也的英雄。
sentences.traditional: 不管有什麼聰明的方法，不管結果怎麼樣，這四千人都是新也的英雄。
sentences.pinyin: bù guǎn yǒu shén me cōng ming de fāng fǎ bù guǎn jié guǒ zěn me yàng zhè sì qiān rén dōu shì xīn yě de yīng xióng
sentences.english: No matter how smart the method, no matter what the result, these 4,000 men were the heroes of Xinye.

sentences.simplified: 三个小时过去了。天快要黑的时候，徐元直终于笑了，他知道他的方法没错。
sentences.traditional: 三個小時過去了。天快要黑的時候，徐元直終於笑了，他知道他的方法沒錯。
sentences.pinyin: sān ge xiǎo shí guò qù le tiān kuài yào hēi de shí hou xú yuán zhí zhōng yú xiào le tā zhī dào tā de fāng fǎ méi cuò
sentences.english: Three hours passed. It was about to get dark when Xu Yuanzhi finally smiled. He knew that his method was correct.

sentences.simplified: 新也城外终于安静了。
sentences.traditional: 新也城外終於安靜了。
sentences.pinyin: xīn yě chéng wài zhōng yú ān jìng le
sentences.english: It was also finally quiet outside of the city of Xinye.

sentences.simplified: 曹仁带着两千多人往北方跑了，但是他回去的路不会好走，
sentences.traditional: 曹仁帶著兩千多人往北方跑了，但是他回去的路不會好走，
sentences.pinyin: cáo rén dài zhe liǎng qiān duō rén wǎng běi fāng pǎo le dàn shì tā huí qù de lù bú huì hǎo zǒu
sentences.english: Cao Ren fled to the north with over 2,000 men, but his journey home would not be smooth.

sentences.simplified: 因为徐元直早就让张飞带着一千人在路上等着曹仁了。
sentences.traditional: 因為徐元直早就讓張飛帶著一千人在路上等著曹仁了。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi xú yuán zhí zǎo jiù ràng zhāng fēi dài zhe yì qiān rén zài lù shang děng zhe cáo rén le
sentences.english: This was because Xu Yuanzhi already had already arranged for Zhang Fei along with 1,000 men to wait for him on his way back.

sentence_translations: Chapter 6: The Heroes of Xinye
Xu Yuanzhi stood in the upper side of Xinye, intently watching the battle that was happening in the lower side.
They had already been fighting for an hour.
The screams of “Kill! Kill! Kill!” were getting louder and louder, and there were more and more men and horses.
Zhao Yun and his troops were like the clouds in the sky.
One minute they were on one side, and the next minute they were on the other.
Cao Ren led his troops to kill Zhao Yun. Zhao Yun ran very fast. Cao Ren ran after him, and he was also very fast.
The troops behind Cao Ren were not as fast as he was, and soon they could no longer see Cao Ren or Zhao Yun.
Cao Ren was still running after Zhao Yun, but Zhao Yun was running too fast.
After a while, Cao Ren also lost sight of Zhao Yun.
It was then that Cao Ren realized that all of the troops behind him were gone.
He searched for a while and was shocked to see that they were all dead. Zhao Yun’s soldiers had come from behind and killed them.
Cao Ren was very anxious and also very angry.
It was then that he saw that Zhao Yun had come back, so he immediately brought some soldiers to kill Zhao Yun.
But after running for a while, things were the same as before.
He lost sight of Zhao Yun again, and the troops behind him disappeared again. They were all killed once again.
Cao Ren’s heart was pounding. He was scared.
He did not understand what was happening, as he had never encountered anyone who fought like Zhao Yun.
Xu Yuanzhi stood in the upper side of the city the entire time.
One moment he was looking among the Xinye army for Zhao Yun, who was riding a white horse and wearing white clothes.
The next moment he was looking among the Cao army for Cao Ren, who was riding a black horse and wearing red clothes.
“Defend Xinye! Defend our home!” Xu Yuanzhi could hear Zhao Yun’s voice very clearly.
“Kill! Kill! Kill!” Xu Yuanzhi could also hear the voice of the Xinye army very clearly.
Now, the Xinye army in the lower side of the city had 4,000 men, and Cao Ren’s army had 30,000 men.
4,000 against 30,000. This was a fight to the death!
No matter how smart the method, no matter what the result, these 4,000 men were the heroes of Xinye.
Three hours passed. It was about to get dark when Xu Yuanzhi finally smiled. He knew that his method was correct.
It was also finally quiet outside of the city of Xinye.
Cao Ren fled to the north with over 2,000 men, but his journey home would not be smooth.
This was because Xu Yuanzhi already had already arranged for Zhang Fei along with 1,000 men to wait for him on his way back.
